text:
Ayesha M: quick flag observed some stale reads (100-300ms) after prefix handoff in canary. repro harness attached to ticket. logs show owner_epoch bumped but cache still serving older blobs.

Jon T: thanks. is prefill finishing before we advertise owner? if we advertise early that's the window.

Ayesha M: yep. we advertise to keep handoff latency low; prefill/warmup is async and can lag.

Priya S: options: (1) read-side epoch guard: consult in-memory owner_epoch and refuse to serve cached entry if cached_epoch < owner_epoch -> sync read; (2) best-effort invalidation publish at handoff; (3) make advertise atomic (wait for local snapshot apply).

Ben L: (1)+(2) is pragmatic: small in-memory lookup + pubsub invalidation. (3) is cleaner but large control-plane change and increases handoff tail.

Ayesha M: ops risk: invalidation storms can cause rehydrate spikes and GPU pressure. need backoff and heuristics (only invalidate recent-write prefixes or hotset).

Priya S: propose short-term: implement epoch-guard on read (RCU-friendly) + publish invalidation with a prefill_hint and nonce. Gate behind runtime flag and canary for 72h. Emit metrics: evict.epoch_mismatch, evict.invalidation_sent, evict.invalidation_fallbacks.

Jon T: implement owner_map entries as {epoch, announce_seq}. use monotonic announce_seq to avoid cross-node clock skew. read path: load owner_map snapshot, compare cached_epoch vs epoch; if mismatch and announce_age < ack_window_ms then sync-check; ack_window default 200ms.

Ben L: add per-prefix cooldown: if invalidations/sec > threshold, suppress for 1s and mark hint prefill=false. ops add dashboard: stale_reads, rehydrate_qps, invalidation_rate, ack_triggers.

Ayesha M: product: default hosted mode uses conservative behavior to minimize user-visible staleness; enterprise customers can opt into "low-latency handoff" which advertises early but tolerates eventual fixup.

Priya S: i'll own read-path PR + tests for lost invalidation and schema-versioned cache entry. Jon will wire invalidation publisher + backoff knobs. Ben will add dashboards and auto-roll back rule: rehydrate_qps > baseline*2.

ops-bot: NOTICE: invalidation topic subscription live on canary nodes (4). monitoring hooks installed.

Ayesha M: thanks. RFC for atomic-handshake will draft next week. landing short-term mitigations behind flag now.
